title: Gen218 Hyperposition object-word conflation and evidence cardinality cliff
delta: Hyperposition now falls back from missing relation_key/predicate to groups formed by one shared normalized content word.
A shared object word does not establish that two values are alternative values of the same predicate; path, hostname and owner statements about the same object may be conflated.
The fallback accepts a token only when it occurs in 2..3 entries. A fourth corroborating or distinct entry removes the entire inferred relation, creating a non-monotonic evidence-cardinality cliff.
Explicit relation_key/predicate remains the stronger path and is not implicated by this fallback defect.
Gen218 reports 780 green and 2 red; the new Auftrag rewrite red and persistent runtime-adapter red remain separate frontiers.

concepts.name: Object-Word Predicate Conflation
concepts.hypothesis: Grouping on one shared long word merges different predicates about the same object into false alternatives.
concepts.counterhypothesis: The length/frequency caps make the shared word specific enough that held-out false groupings remain negligible.

concepts.name: Evidence Cardinality Cliff
concepts.hypothesis: For an inferred relation visible with 2 or 3 entries, adding a fourth entry makes the relation disappear because _GEGENSTAND_MAX_EINTRAEGE=3.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Real retrieval windows never contain four entries sharing a specific token, so the branch is practically unreachable.

concepts.name: Hyperposition Reachability Substitution
concepts.hypothesis: The fallback turns a previously unreachable mechanism into a visible but semantically noisier one; non-empty output alone is not correctness evidence.
concepts.counterhypothesis: Downstream uncertainty labeling prevents false grouping from affecting answers or promotion.

falsifiers.design: On one exact source/tree, build a blinded matrix with explicit relation keys and fallback-only memories. Cross path/hostname/owner/status predicates for the same named object; include true alternative values of one predicate.
falsifiers.acceptance: No cross-predicate grouping; explicit-key arm remains stable; fallback precision and recall reported separately.

falsifiers.design: For each true and false relation, add entries sequentially n=1..6 while holding all prior entries fixed and permute order.
falsifiers.acceptance: Adding corroborating evidence must not silently delete a previously emitted relation; any cap must truncate facets with an explicit receipt, not erase the relation.

falsifiers.design: Repeat the existing whole-GWT channel lesion with hyperposition off, explicit-only, fallback-only and full modes using opaque IDs and held-out questions.
falsifiers.acceptance: No causal credit from non-empty readouts or same-family aggregate probes; require paired held-out executable outcomes.
